stage_vocabulary.RUNNING: Being run now; no result recorded yet.
stage_vocabulary.PASS: Run and scored; answer matches ground truth and states its reading where required. Terminal.
stage_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Run and scored; right in part (number, premise or framing), or reliability unproven. Terminal.
stage_vocabulary.FAIL: Run and scored; answer wrong or no answer. Terminal.
stage_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Cannot be scored or closed until an open decision is ruled. Not terminal.

Cloudflare needs the Worker up first: cd /Users/justin/github/_misc/_chat/f1-chat && npx --no-install wrangler dev --port 8787. Stop only that process; other wrangler dev processes belong to off-the-pace-chat.
